title: Australian Lamb Skewers with Herb Crust
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish featuring lamb skewers with a delicious herb crust, perfect for a quick dinner or outdoor gathering.

ingredients.name: Fresh herb
ingredients.notes: chopped, such as parsley or rosemary

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: wooden or metal, soaked in water for 30 minutes

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together chopped herb, crusted seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush skewers with olive oil and sprinkle with herb mixture.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional chopped herb if desired.
